 Santiago & Romero Law Group
 Baytown, TX
 Phone 832-555-2357
 Settlement Demand
09/24/2023
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1148 - Demand for settlement
Dear Claims Representative:
Our office represents Jennifer Tyler in connection with the motor vehicle collisoin that occurred on 05/30/2023. Our client was
operating a vehicle in the ordinary course of travel when your insured's vehicle crossed into the opposing lane and struck our
client's car head-on. Although the impact occurred at a low rate of speed, the force was sufficient to cause immediate pain and
restricted movement. Our client was transported for evaluation and later diagnosed with cervical and lumbar strain, accompanied
by muscle spasm, headaches, and reduced range of motion. Treatment has included physical therapy and prescribed medication,
and our client continues to experience limitations in daily activities, sleep, and work duties.
The police report documents the lane departure by your insured and records that our client was not at fault. Liability under the
circumstances is clear, and we see no reasonable basis for disputing it.
Based on the medical records, treatment charges, lost wages, and the impact on our client's quality of life, we are prepared to
resolve this cliam for the sum of $185,000.00. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not
receive a satisfactory response within that period, we will file suit without further notice to your company.
Expert review: Anthony Davis, neurologist
Sincerely,
Eric Phillips
Santiago & Romero Law Group
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
